gaps.explanation: Statement lines come from the accrual proprietary funds statement p6 (printed p8): operating revenues 643,093 + interest 3,120 + gain on disposal 15,000 = 661,213 (Water 378,016 + 2,871 + 15,000 = 395,887; Sewer 265,077 + 249 = 265,326; Other Proprietary Fund 0). Detail comes from the budgetary-basis schedules: Water p17 (printed p28) total revenues 401,146, Sewer p18 (p29) 852,777, Meter Deposit Fund p19 Miscellaneous 3,450 = 1,257,373. Per fund: Water 401,146 - 395,887 = 5,259; Sewer 852,777 - 265,326 = 587,451 (the budgetary Miscellaneous 597,494 includes the 591,361 bond proceeds that the accrual statement records as debt, cash flow statement p7 'Bond proceeds 591,361'); Meter Deposit 3,450 (deposits, budgetary only) => 596,160 = schedule excess. Both totals correct on their own basis; no detail line is a duplicate; no fix.
